definitions.gloss: sweet spot; dead center; exact center of a bat or racket
definitions.explanation: The precise center point of a striking surface — the spot on a bat, racket, golf club, or similar implement where the hit feels cleanest and produces the best result. By extension, can mean hitting something right on target.

examples.japanese: バットの{真芯|ましん}で{捉|とら}えた。
examples.english: I caught it right on the sweet spot of the bat.

examples.japanese: {真芯|ましん}に{当|あ}たると{気持|きも}ちのいい{打球|だきゅう}が{飛|と}ぶ。
examples.english: When you hit the sweet spot, the ball flies with a satisfying feel.

examples.japanese: ゴルフで{真芯|ましん}を{捉|とら}えるには、スイングのフォームを{安定|あんてい}させることが{大事|だいじ}だ。
examples.english: To hit the sweet spot in golf, it's important to stabilize your swing form.

notes:
Composed of {真|ま} (true; exact) and {芯|しん} (core; center). Primarily a sports term used in baseball, golf, tennis, and other bat/racket/club sports. Hitting the {真芯|ましん} produces maximum power transfer with minimal vibration in the hands.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真芯|ましん}で{捉|とら}える: to catch/hit on the sweet spot
- {真芯|ましん}に{当|あ}てる: to hit the sweet spot
- {真芯|ましん}を{食|く}う: to connect with the sweet spot (baseball)
- バットの{真芯|ましん}: the sweet spot of a bat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {芯|しん}: core; center — the general term for the middle or core of something
- {中心|ちゅうしん}: center — more general, used for any center point
- ジャストミート: perfect contact — loanword used in baseball for hitting the ball cleanly
